name: Mahoutsukai
source:
A mysterious young man who invariably appears in every tale. For some reason, he gives off a different impression at each encounter; his personality is difficult to grasp. He seems to have some sort of goal, yet...

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/10/17/taisho-alice-introduction/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
